includeSubtasks.title: Include subtasks
includeSubtasks.description: Recursively includes subtasks in deterministic pre-order.

includeTaskRelationDiagram.title: Include task relation diagram
includeTaskRelationDiagram.description: Adds a Mermaid diagram for relations among exported tasks.

includeFields.title: Include fields
includeFields.description: Adds configured issue fields to each exported task.

includeTags.title: Include tags
includeTags.description: Adds issue tags to each exported task.

separateFilesForMultipleTasks.title: Separate files for multiple tasks
separateFilesForMultipleTasks.description: Enables a separate Markdown file inside the ZIP download when multiple tasks are exported.
